actual: Fresh BUG submission performs OPEN and MERGED stale-PR searches even though the allocated ID is new, and postmortem repeats the same remote queries. Canonical BUG lookup also reparses the full registry, while the implemented terminal-reservation compactor is not wired into production. Remove impossible fresh-ID searches, reuse durable workflow state for postmortem, use exact BUG-ID candidate lookup with duplicate detection, and compact only safely terminal reservations without weakening collision fail-closed behavior.
